cases.translation: He set the turban on his head. He set the golden plate, the holy crown, on the front of the turban, as Yahweh commanded Moses.

cases.translation: He brought the bull of the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the bull of the sin offering.

cases.sentence: Моисей заколол барана, взял кровь и помазал ею мочку ___ Аарона, большой палец его правой руки и большой палец правой ноги.

cases.translation: He killed it; and Moses took some of its blood, and put it on the tip of Aaron’s right ear, and on the thumb of his right hand, and on the great toe of his right foot.
